nodes.rationale: Product changes described in specs/ before expanding surface; Spec Kit order constitution->specify->plan->tasks->implement.

nodes.label: Ponytail (minimo que cumple)
nodes.rationale: No dependency, layer or screen the RFP does not require; reuse SQLite/IndexedDB/face-api; exceptions marked ponytail: with ceiling and upgrade path.

nodes.label: Hardware-agnostic principle
nodes.rationale: Same URL in Chrome/Chromium; no Electron, Pi agents or USB SDK; camera only via getUserMedia.

nodes.label: Offline no silencioso
nodes.rationale: ULID punches, visible IndexedDB queue, idempotent sync; never lose a punch.

nodes.label: Consentimiento y auditoria
nodes.rationale: No template without consent; revocation deletes descriptors; every enroll/punch/revocation emits event.

nodes.label: DEMO explicito
nodes.rationale: UI carries DEMO badge; no claim of production PAD or template E2EE.

nodes.label: UX Inbox
nodes.rationale: Clear interface, whitespace, thin type, high contrast; hover = soft shade.

nodes.label: Next.js breaking-changes notice
nodes.rationale: Agents must read node_modules/next/dist/docs before coding because this Next.js version differs from training data.

nodes.label: PIN supervisor fallback (F08/B05)
nodes.rationale: Alternative modality is software-controlled PIN + reason + log instead of USB RFID/fingerprint drivers.

nodes.label: TLS via reverse proxy (Caddy/nginx)
nodes.rationale: App does not terminate TLS; camera requires HTTPS on public internet.

nodes.label: Software-complete vs contractual split
nodes.rationale: Honest separation: software delivers kiosk/API/RBAC; bidder contracts SLA, ISO/SOC, CR cloud region, FAR/FRR lab test.

nodes.label: AI pack v1.1
nodes.rationale: AI operates only on persisted trusted punches, never replaces biometrics; every answer cites ids and date range/deep link.

nodes.label: P2 chat Pregunta a Reloj CR
nodes.norm_label: p2 chat pregunta a reloj cr

nodes.label: NVIDIA Nemotron LLM provider
nodes.rationale: Called via OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions without stream; temperature 0.2 to avoid inventing names.

nodes.label: SQL template fallback (no LLM key)
nodes.rationale: Without any LLM key briefing and chat use SQL templates; no egress to LLM.

nodes.label: LLM egress privacy (aggregates + ids only)
nodes.rationale: No face descriptors, PIN, hashes or TEMPLATE_KEY leave the server.

nodes.label: AI prohibitions (no punitive score, no CCTV)
nodes.norm_label: ai prohibitions (no punitive score, no cctv)

nodes.label: Passive liveness heuristic (EAR blink / nose motion)
nodes.rationale: Not certified PAD (ISO 30107-3); leaves software hook to swap in third-party PAD engine; failure routes to supervisor PIN, never free punch.
nodes.norm_label: passive liveness heuristic (ear blink / nose motion)

nodes.label: RPO/RTO assumptions
nodes.rationale: Software assumptions (RPO 24h, RTO minutes), not a sold SLA.

nodes.label: Render Docker deployment
nodes.rationale: Docker used because better-sqlite3 needs a compiler; Starter plan required for persistent /data disk; single instance since SQLite is not shared.

nodes.label: Docker Desktop path (Windows)
nodes.rationale: Recommended on Windows to avoid compiling better-sqlite3.
